### UI & HUD
- Fixed status info not rendering on Windows host consoles.

items.text: Added new power grid rooms for Launch Site, Trainyard, and Radtown.
Livestock trust, gender, and status panel info are hidden by default and can be toggled by admins, with visibility now controlled server‑side.
Fixed livestock runtime pattern generation to match intended design ranges.
Improved livestock AI: cows no longer chase unreachable targets, herd and trough selection consider multiple options, bulls stop charging unreachable targets, and curious cows eat as expected.
Fixed turtle swimming movement, ensuring proper behavior in shallow water and preventing swimming into terrain.
Added inventory interaction sounds for animal fences.
Ladders now work correctly, restoring reliable climbing on structures.
Train tracks now generate smoother, passable junctions; impassable angles and confusing switches have been fixed.
Wolf skulls can no longer be harvested from farm animals, removing that loot source.
New meat type added to the loot table and a crash that prevented animals from being chased from behind has been fixed, improving AI behavior.
Inbred cows now display correct textures, fixing the visual mix‑up between healthy and inbred animals.
Grenade client prediction errors are now silently ignored, reducing disruptive prediction glitches.
Store items show loading placeholders generated from BlurHash, preventing blank images while textures load.
Store item tiles retain their cover images during loading, keeping UI appearance consistent.
Colored sky lanterns and boltie now have correct descriptions, fixing missing or typoed info.

2026-09-11.summary:
### World & Structures
- Added new power grid rooms for Launch Site, Trainyard, and Radtown.

### Livestock & Animal Systems
- Livestock trust, gender, and status panel info are hidden by default and can be toggled by admins, with visibility now controlled server‑side.
- Fixed livestock runtime pattern generation to match intended design ranges.
- Improved livestock AI: cows no longer chase unreachable targets, herd and trough selection consider multiple options, bulls stop charging unreachable targets, and curious cows eat as expected.
- Fixed turtle swimming movement, ensuring proper behavior in shallow water and preventing swimming into terrain.
- Added inventory interaction sounds for animal fences.

### Base Building
- Ladders now work correctly, restoring reliable climbing on structures.

### Transportation
- Train tracks now generate smoother, passable junctions; impassable angles and confusing switches have been fixed.

### Loot & Resources
- Wolf skulls can no longer be harvested from farm animals, removing that loot source.
- New meat type added to the loot table and a crash that prevented animals from being chased from behind has been fixed, improving AI behavior.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Inbred cows now display correct textures, fixing the visual mix‑up between healthy and inbred animals.
- Grenade client prediction errors are now silently ignored, reducing disruptive prediction glitches.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Store items show loading placeholders generated from BlurHash, preventing blank images while textures load.
- Store item tiles retain their cover images during loading, keeping UI appearance consistent.
- Colored sky lanterns and boltie now have correct descriptions, fixing missing or typoed info.

items.text: Rust+ now correctly displays custom monument marker names on the mobile app.
Bradley flatbed ladder climbing and moving‑train boarding fixed: ladders and parenting volumes enlarged for easier access and proper boarding of moving trains.
Cows no longer slide away when hurt or dying; they now get up properly and play the appropriate animation.
Bulls now defend against other animals and can protect their owner's base from other players, not just the herd from players.
Added a new loot room in the Military Tunnels, providing additional high‑tier loot opportunities.
Fixed missing images on pack overlay buttons and main section, restoring proper UI visuals.
Ensured store items' CoverImage loads correctly, fixing the Factory Door display in the store.
Added missing cactus gib, so destroying cactus now shows proper debris.
Updated SkinTile component to use CoverImage, removing redundant SkinTile_General and correcting UI rendering across the store.

2026-09-10.summary:
### Monument & Map Integration
- Rust+ now correctly displays custom monument marker names on the mobile app.

### Vehicle & Structure Interaction
- Bradley flatbed ladder climbing and moving‑train boarding fixed: ladders and parenting volumes enlarged for easier access and proper boarding of moving trains.

### Animal Behavior
- Cows no longer slide away when hurt or dying; they now get up properly and play the appropriate animation.

### NPC & AI
- Bulls now defend against other animals and can protect their owner's base from other players, not just the herd from players.

### World & Loot
- Added a new loot room in the Military Tunnels, providing additional high‑tier loot opportunities.

### UI & Visuals
- Fixed missing images on pack overlay buttons and main section, restoring proper UI visuals.
- Ensured store items' CoverImage loads correctly, fixing the Factory Door display in the store.
- Added missing cactus gib, so destroying cactus now shows proper debris.
- Updated SkinTile component to use CoverImage, removing redundant SkinTile_General and correcting UI rendering across the store.
